description:
The Digital Consumer team powers digital experiences and engagement to enhance the lives of millions of people every day through connected care. We build, deliver and manage a portfolio of data management platforms and mobile offerings in support of our core businesses. We thrive on simple and elegant architecture and agility. You’ll be immersed in a dynamic high-growth environment and empowered to excel, take informed risks, and drive ingenuity across the enterprise. 
   
 Location - San Diego, US (hybrid) 
 
 Let’s talk about the team and you: 
   
 As an iOS Engineer, you will be part of a highly collaborative team working on modern mobile technologies in the growing digital health space. We’re a team of engineers, designers, and product professionals who are passionate about creating meaningful experiences that help people around the world breathe easier. 
   
 You will be part of a team that partners closely with UX designers, product managers, and platform engineers to build and evolve shared UI foundations used throughout our digital consumer experiences. You will also collaborate with product teams to ensure these foundations enable the delivery of high-quality customer experiences across our mobile applications. 
   
 You will work closely with talented engineers, designers, product managers, architects, and stakeholders to deliver industry-leading mobile applications while helping establish patterns and components that can be leveraged across teams. 
   
 Let’s talk about responsibilities 
   
 Responsible for developing high-quality iOS applications and shared mobile components 

 Contribute to the design, implementation, and evolution of reusable UI components and shared mobile frameworks 

 Partner closely with UX designers to translate design patterns into scalable, accessible, and maintainable implementation 

 Drive consistency, quality, and usability across our mobile applications through shared components and best practices 

 Collaborate with other engineers and product owners to identify software solutions to complex problems in our industry 

 Advocate for accessibility, performance, and developer experience when building shared solutions 

 Collaborate with engineers across teams, including Android counterparts, to encourage consistency and continuous improvement of shared mobile capabilities 

 Take a quality-first approach to software development by producing unit tests and automating functional testing wherever possible 

 Leverage modern development tools, including AI-assisted engineering workflows, to improve productivity, code quality, and team effectiveness 

 Conduct code reviews with other developers 

 Support and mentor other engineers through collaboration, code reviews, and knowledge sharing 

 Participate in technical interviews 

   
 Let’s talk about qualifications and experience 
   
 You must be a seasoned iOS developer, with at least 3 years of mobile development experience 
 
 Hands-on experience developing apps in Swift for at least 3 years   

 Experience designing and architecting iOS applications and understanding various design patterns 

 Experience with the use of Continuous Integration and automated testing frameworks 

 Experience working with SwiftUI and modern iOS development practice 

 Experience collaborating with designers and cross-functional product teams 

 Familiarity with accessibility standards and inclusive design principles 

 Experience working with peripherals, wearables, and Bluetooth is desirable 

 Master’s Degree in Computer Science or related discipline with 3+ years of experience; or Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of experience in design and development 

 2+ years of experience making a significant individual contribution to real-world software development 

   
 Preferred Qualifications 
   
 Experience building reusable UI components, frameworks, or shared libraries 

 Experience contributing to or implementing a Design System 

 Experience working with modular architectures and Swift Package Manage 

 Experience collaborating with Android engineers to deliver consistent cross-platform experiences 

   
 Let’s talk about what you can expect 
   
 A supportive environment that focuses on people development, collaboration, and engineering excellence 

 Opportunity to influence shared mobile foundations used across multiple products and teams 

 Work closely with engineers, designers, and product teams to solve meaningful customer problems 

 Exposure to modern mobile development practices, tooling, and AI-assisted engineering workflows 

 Work with global teams and share new ideas 

 Be supported both inside and outside of the work environment 

 The opportunity to build products that have a direct impact on people’s lives 

 
 Why join us   
 At Resmed, you’ll be part of a mission driven company focused on improving health and quality of life. This role offers high visibility, the chance to learn from senior brand leaders, and the opportunity to shape how Resmed shows up across global markets. You’ll grow your skills in brand strategy, cross functional collaboration, and brand governance at scale.  
   
 We are shaping the future at Resmed, and we recognize the need to build on and broaden our existing skills and continue to attract and retain the world’s best talent. We work hard to offer holistic benefits packages, provide flexible work arrangements, cultivate a workforce culture that allows employees to grow personally and professionally, and deliver competitive salaries to our team members. Employees scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week are eligible for benefits. This position qualifies for the following benefits package: comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and life, AD&D, short-term and long-term disability insurance, sleep care management, Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), commuter benefits, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and tuition assistance. Employees receive Flexible Time Off (FTO), receive 11 paid holidays plus 3 floating days and are eligible for 14 weeks of primary caregiver or two weeks of secondary caregiver leave when welcoming new family members. 
   
 Individual pay decisions are based on a variety of factors, such as the candidate’s geographic work location, relevant qualifications, work experience, and skills. 
   
 At Resmed, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.  A reasonable estimate of the current base range for this position is: $111,000 - $167,000 USD. 
 
 
 
 Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now! We commit to respond to every applicant.
